claim: Constructive 6-round (k=2..7) rewrite of the 36-call 111-port strong binary word removes 7 MOVE instructions (2803 -> 2796), reduces dirty clears (3433 -> 3426), and lowers paid linear capacity from 104,904 ports (sum 285,600) to 104,652 ports (sum 284,592) while preserving exact register semantics across all 630 registers. Rebased into the unpowered retimed multiplier architecture of PR #8042 / PR #8050, this raises BINARY_C from 287039844436133239/2^66 (0.003890115286594461...) to 4391986206293/2^50 (0.003900867368050091...), eliminates the binary bottleneck, preserves GAUSSIAN_C = 2092819/2^29 unmodified and log2_fixed_setup_and_install_le = 513, shrinks the binary hierarchy from 7 stages to 2 stages (60000, 960000), and lifts conditional kappa to 0.003893947 (H=36000), 0.003898026 (H=1000000), 0.003898163 (H=10000000), and 0.003898171 (H=20000000), conditional on five inherited all-size framework obligations.
actual_scope: Complete finite-machine constructive verification and retimed unpowered cost accounting for the modified 111-port binary word (seed_k7) paired with the unmodified 2-scale (1,8) retimed complex receiver of PR #8042; full production-payload execution and independent all-size proof of the five inherited framework obligations remain open.
scope_change_reason: Because PR #8042 and PR #8050 freeze the underlying 2-scale Gaussian supplier (GAUSSIAN_C = 2092819/2^29), improving only the binary word moves the overall unpowered bottleneck cleanly from binary to Gaussian while reducing binary depth to 2 stages and shrinking required numerical_H/public_exponent_A dramatically; full Lean 4 proof diffs and Gaussian supplier optimization are separated as explicit follow-up work.
bottleneck_link: Replaces the binary coupling bottleneck (~0.003890115) with seed_k7 BINARY_C = 4391986206293/2^50 (~0.003900867), leaving the unmodified PR #8042 GAUSSIAN_C = 2092819/2^29 (~0.003898179) minus 39/(256*numerical_H) as the active ceiling.
stop_rule: Stopped after constructive binary optimization reached kappa=0.003898171 within GAUSSIAN_C=2092819/2^29 and passed all eight independent verify.py gates.
evidence: research/p104-k7-retimed-binary/RESULT.json, research/p104-k7-retimed-binary/K7-STACK-LEDGER.json, research/p104-k7-retimed-binary/VERIFY.json, and all eight verify.py executable checks.
